selection_reason: Ben chose the served design (Gibbs m5-nocurves + unitdescpluto-v3) refit with the divergence review's quarantine (data rule quarantine-v1: 143 advertisements that their own words or MapPLUTO show are not an open-market lease of a whole Chelsea apartment at the recorded address), and asked that the site say which listings are quarantined. Accuracy ties the previous selection on the rows both keep (PSIS-LOO +8.9 ± 13.5, held-out +2.7 ± 3.1); 1,361 s on the RTX 2060. The site lists the quarantined listings with the review's reason and no estimate.
uncertainty: Conditional posterior uncertainty; source errors, omitted features and incomplete market coverage remain separate. Estimates for a unit's only listing are under-covered (91.6% in the 95% predictive range).
